notes: Two of the verse's three article morphemes go unrendered: the rectum's, because the ASV writes heavens of heavens with no the, and the vocative's, because rule 36 leaves the ye with the noun.

An alternative reading would head the fused `מֵעַל` on the second morpheme as the one whose sense above carries; rule 23 settles it on the governing first morpheme, since neither carries content the other lacks, and rule 23 names `מֵעַל` expressly.
The relative clause is verbless with a prepositional predicate, so its supplied copula joins the preposition under rule 49 and the target head is the English preposition.
